routes.route: City of Košice GISPLAN cadastral viewer
routes.outcome: Public viewer found; page identifies cadastral map and credits Kataster/ÚGKK SR. Viewer is usable for human inspection, but its JavaScript API/configuration was not promoted as a stable adapter contract in this packet.
HTTP 200; WFS 2.0.0; layer cp:CP.CadastralParcel; default CRS EPSG:4258; provider VÚGK; C-register scope covers Slovakia; application/json supported; no authentication.

routes.route: Slovak INSPIRE C-register WFS bounded city-area query
routes.outcome: HTTP 200 anonymous JSON; 9,556 matched, three returned due to COUNT=3; full Polygon geometries and safe cadastral identities returned.

routes.route: Slovak INSPIRE C-register WFS exact-point neighborhood query
routes.outcome: HTTP 200 anonymous JSON; polygons returned near the exact WUP point. No coordinate shift or exact-hit inference was used.

schemaAndIdentity.crs: EPSG:4258 (ETRS89 geographic; GeoJSON response observed with longitude/latitude coordinate order)
schemaAndIdentity.nativeIdentity: Preferred stable identity is inspireId.localId / nationalCadastralReference, with WFS feature id CP.<number> retained as a source feature identity. Example localId 827118_1862/5.C, label 1862/5.

fieldMapping.native id: inspireId.localId, nationalCadastralReference, or WFS feature id
fieldMapping.optional safe facts: label, areaValue.value, areaValue.@uom, referencePoint, validFrom, validTo, administrativeUnit.@href

scopeLimits: Bounded requests are qualification evidence only and do not establish complete Košice coverage.
The exact WUP point [48.7182343856836, 21.2550572326794] was preserved; no point-in-polygon claim is made.
The viewer and national WFS are source evidence, not runtime adapter admission.
No retained GeoJSON sample was written; therefore no source-specific attribute set was retained.

completionSummary.registryEvidence: local viewer plus first-party national WFS
